statement: An :apply with MERGE whose file leaves out entries of the head keeps them, and its change carries one WARNING finding (check OPERATION) per section ($.policies, $.bindings, $.roles, $.rateLimits) that names the kept ids and says that REPLACE removes them. A REPLACE carries none: what it removes are its operations.
guards: control:ChangesTest#apply merges or replaces, guarded by what it read
